provenance: Exfiltrated from the Squire campaign-tracker prototype (github.com/maz-org/squire-campaign-tracker, src/GloomhavenTracker.jsx), which curated it from Lurkars/gloomhavensecretariat data plus community flowcharts. Advisory by design: trust the game when it disagrees. Scenario keys are module-local; campaigns store them qualified as "<module>:<key>".
